name: Paco Coursey
summary: One move: the page's text enters on a plain 0.6s ease, staggered in 0.12s steps from the heading down. Links underline in 0.24s. Then nothing moves.
notes: The entrance animates opacity and transform together, with delays of 0s, 0.12s, 0.24s, 0.36s, 0.6s and 0.72s down the page.
With reduced motion on, the entrance doesn't run at all: 8 movement events became 0.
The statement is the keyword ease. Not an aggressive ease-out, and not long.
